text:
5.9 If it is established a person is unwilling to co-operate sufficiently to enable a search and/or
examination to take place or a suitable photograph to be taken, an officer may use
reasonable force to:
(a) search and/or examine a detainee without their consent; and
(b) photograph any identifying marks without their consent.

5.10 The thoroughness and extent of any search or examination carried out in accordance with
the powers in section 54A must be no more than the officer considers necessary to achieve
the required purpose. Any search or examination which involves the removal of more than
the person’s outer clothing shall be conducted in accordance with Code C, Annex A,
paragraph 11.
